text.jp:
ふふん、なんとわかりやすい人でしょう。
ずばり、私を仲間にしたいと思っていますね！？
text.official_en:
Well, it's plain as day. You want me to join your
group, don't you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カターニャ

text.jp:
「レダ」の名は、人々の間で噂になっています！
それで、私を仲間にするつもりで来られたのですか？
text.official_en:
It seems that people have been spreading word of a
"Leda." So, you've come to make me your ally?

やはりそうでしたか。無理もありませんね。
何せ私は当代無比の最高の騎士ですから。
text.official_en:
I knew it. Who can blame you? I'm one of the most
superlative knights of this age.

今の貴女なら、我が槍を捧ぐに申し分ありません。
text.official_en:
I thought as much. Excuse any earlier rudeness. You
are now a fitting match for my spear and service.

貴方は私の主ではありません。あくまで仲間です！

So we will fight together, starting today. I'm glad to
serve you—though as an ally, not my lord!
